title.narrative: Economic Empowerment for Women & Youth through Dairy Agribusiness Project ver. 2

description.narrative: The project, "Economic Empowerment and Financial Inclusion of Women and Youth through Dairy Agribusiness," is implemented by CREMPA in Malawi, focusing on Milk Bulking Cooperatives (MBCs) in Dowa, Mchinji, and Ntchisi districts. Its main purpose is to empower women and youth through dairy agribusiness by enhancing their technical skills, financial inclusion, and participation in decision-making. Key activities include training in dairy management, financial literacy, artificial insemination, milk value addition, and land tenure rights. The project also strengthens Group Savings and Loans Groups (GSLGs) and links farmers to formal financial services. Operating in a challenging context of economic instability (currency devaluation) and climate variability, the project aims to build resilient livelihoods and promote gender equality in dairy value chains
